blocks.text: Logical inference is the process of deriving new facts from known information. It is a way of reasoning that follows logical rules. For example, if we know “All humans are mortal” and “Socrates is a human,” we can infer that “Socrates is mortal.” Logical inference ensures conclusions are true if the premises are true. It is used in mathematics, computer science, and artificial intelligence. Inference helps in making decisions based on evidence. It is a fundamental concept in logic and reasoning.
